$comment: Built-in SSTRE platform profile. Upload limit and engine settings from EXP-016 (tex_iNormalSize=11 = 2048x2048 upload area; the >2048 px width crash of EXP-012 is fixed in the engine); Vulkan texture pool from EXP-016. Formats from RD-006 section 4, EXP-014 and EXP-009.
title: PC (Windows/Linux), Classic-VK raster + experimental RT

textureLimits.notes: The runtime uploads at most 4^tex_iNormalSize pixels (EXP-016); with the engine settings below that is a 2048x2048 area, so larger sources are reduced here instead of at load time. Widths above 2048 need the FilterBitmap fix (EXP-016).

targets.notes: Loose v4 .tex with identical mex; mip 0 only, the runtime builds mips. Material maps are not used by the raster baseline.
OverridenTextures/Compressed/<texture path>{,_n,_rme}.ktx2; coexists with loose .tex (EXP-009 R7). Reader render test passed (EXP-009 R6).

cvars.name: sam_iVideoSetup
cvars.note: custom video setup: the shipped GLSettings scripts are not re-applied over these values

cvars.name: tex_iNormalQuality
cvars.note: 32-bit uploads on OpenGL (no RGB5/RGBA4 plus dithering)

additionalBudgets.notes: Classic-VK suballocates every raster texture from one device-local pool allocated up front (256*256*4*4/3 x 512 x 3 = 536870912 bytes) and stores every format as RGBA8; the pool does not grow, and a texture that does not fit is dropped. Counted per game over all planned assets (an upper bound: a level loads a subset).
